protocol.stage: prospective confirmation; locked before any new target outcome
protocol.statistical_unit: SUT parameter profile; mean over two coordinate pools and five predictor seeds
protocol.zero_failure_pool: normalized area=0 and recall=1 for every method; retained with zero paired differences
protocol.testing: six exact two-sided paired sign-flip tests with Holm correction
protocol.test_assumption: paired profile differences have exchangeable signs under their respective null
protocol.confidence_interval: paired profile bootstrap, resampled within controller type; 20000 replicates
protocol.success_rule: positive means and Holm p below round_alpha for both metrics versus all three primary controls; both bootstrap CI lower bounds above zero versus previous_best
protocol.multiple_rounds: round r spends 0.05/2**r; failed confirmation becomes development, next round uses new profiles and coordinates
protocol.selection_feedback: queried continuous risk only; RAS receives queried binary collision only
protocol.scope: new IDM/FVDM parameter profiles in declared ranges, same simulator and two finite scenario families
